shared_elements: front-facing vertically oriented figure or figure-like outline
bilateral symmetry around a central vertical axis
horizontal band across the middle or lower middle
justification: The strongest correspondence is a frontal, bilaterally symmetrical composition with a central vertical line and horizontal/curved bands of geometric decoration. The biggest difference is that A depicts an explicit anthropomorphic body with face/body parts and relief-like features, while B is mainly a schematic linear geometric design with triangles, arches, and a scalloped band but no clear face or body parts.
